h1: AIVideosUGC FAQ: Answers Before You Start
lead: Find direct answers about AI product videos, photos, credit charges, privacy, and using your finished files in ads.
card: Lengths, credits, actors, voice, captions, music, and publishing.
secondary_keywords: credits and refunds for AI content

faq.q: How do I make an AI product video?
faq.a: Upload a product photo or paste a product page link, describe the scene, and choose the length and frame. The result can include an AI actor, spoken voice, captions, and music; download it or send it to TikTok or Meta.

faq.q: What is an AI UGC ad?
faq.a: An AI UGC ad presents a product in the casual style of a shopper video, with a presenter and voice generated by the tool. Use the result as product content and label it according to the rules where you publish.

faq.q: Why use an AI UGC ad for a product listing?
faq.a: It gives a still product reference a presenter, movement, and a spoken explanation that can fit a social feed or listing. Start with one clear product image and choose the format that suits the channel.

faq.q: Which plans and credit amounts are available?
faq.a: Starter is $24.50 per month for 200 credits, Pro is $35 for 300, and Premium is $63 for 600. A product photo uses 24 credits; a video uses 24, 40, 60, or 120 credits for 6, 10, 15, or 30 seconds. See [Pricing](page:pricing).

faq.q: What happens after I approve a job?
faq.a: The job runs against the displayed credit charge, and the file becomes available in your account when it is ready. A failed job returns its reserved credits automatically.

faq.q: Can I start from a product page link?
faq.a: Yes. Paste a public product page that you are allowed to use, and the tool can use that page as the starting reference for the video. Review the result against the product before publishing.

faq.q: What lengths and frames can I select?
faq.a: Choose 6, 10, 15, or 30 seconds. Frames are 9:16, 1:1, 16:9, 4:3, and 3:4; product photos are square. The credit charge appears before you start.

faq.q: What kind of photo should I upload?
faq.a: Use a sharp photo where the whole product is visible and its color is easy to judge. A clean reference gives the generated image or video a reliable starting point.

faq.q: Who can see my uploads and generated files?
faq.a: Other customers cannot see them. Your uploads and generated files stay in your account and are not published.

faq.q: Can I use the images and videos in my own ads?
faq.a: Yes. Use downloaded images and videos on your product pages, in your ads, and in social posts. Follow the requirements of the platform where you publish.
No. Downloaded images and videos do not include an AIVideosUGC watermark.

faq.q: Can I edit a file after it is generated?
faq.a: Yes. The editor can change the words, captions, voice, or presenter, and you can start another job when you want a different scene.
